app.disclaimer: HappyGut supports self-management. It is a competition prototype, not a medical device, and doesn't diagnose, treat or replace your doctor.
app.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

welcome.title_1: Know what your gut can take,
welcome.lead: Snap a meal or type it in Bangla or English. HappyGut tells you whether it's likely to trigger you, shows the evidence, and suggests something gentler. Every night it learns a little more about you.
welcome.server_down: Can't reach the HappyGut server. Is the backend running?
welcome.f_check_text: Graded, never just "safe": likely OK, caution, likely trigger, or not sure.
welcome.f_diary_text: Food, stomach, stool, sleep and stress, in one short check before bed.
welcome.f_patterns_text: Late nights? Exam weeks? High-fat meals? See what is linked to your worse days.
welcome.f_safety_text: Warning signs stop all food advice and send you to a doctor. No medication advice, ever.
welcome.ex_1_why: High fat. Your diary: often followed by symptoms.
welcome.ex_2_why: Rich in milk and fat. Mind the portion.
welcome.ex_3_why: Nothing in it is flagged for you.
welcome.sign_in_note: Use the account details you were given.
welcome.wrong_credentials: That email or password isn't right. Please try again.
welcome.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
welcome.sign_in_off: Sign-in isn't available on this server yet.

today.nudge_text: Your symptoms have tended to get worse in periods like this. Gentler meals and regular sleep may help.
today.check_text: Photo, or type it in Bangla or English
today.diary_text: Two minutes before bed: food, stomach, sleep, stress.

check.title: Check a meal
check.subtitle: Is this likely to trigger you? Find out before you eat.
check.photo_off: Photo recognition is switched off on this server (no AI key yet). Typing the dish names works.
check.placeholder: e.g. kacchi biryani, borhani and firni
check.ex_2: plain rice, masoor dal, rui macher jhol
check.privacy: Names and phone numbers are removed before any AI sees your text. Photo location data is stripped.
check.no_notable_components: No component at a medium or high level.
check.personal_linked: {{component}} has often been followed by symptoms for you ({{n}} times logged).
check.personal_unclear: {{component}} may be linked to your symptoms, but it isn't clear yet ({{n}} times logged).
check.personal_tolerated: {{component}} has rarely been followed by symptoms for you ({{n}} times logged).
check.engine_note: Verdict computed by HappyGut's tested rules engine ({{version}}), not by an AI model.
check.logged: This meal is logged and will be waiting in tonight's diary.
check.err_photo_unavailable: We couldn't read the photo right now. Please type the dish names instead.
check.err_too_large: That photo is too large. Please choose one under 8 MB.
check.err_not_image: That file isn't a photo we can read. Please use a JPG, PNG or WebP.

redflag.no_advice: HappyGut is not giving food advice right now.

diary.title: Nightly diary
diary.too_late: This day can no longer be edited (a diary can be filled in up to 2 days late).
diary.q_food_hint: Meals you checked are already here. Add anything missing, and tap what a food did to you.
diary.no_food: Nothing logged yet for this day.
diary.add_food_hint: Type in Bangla or English. Pick a match so HappyGut knows what's in it.
diary.sign_dizzy_or_little_urine: Very dizzy, or passing very little urine
diary.q_sleep: How did you sleep last night?
diary.notes_placeholder: Small details help: "ate at a wedding", "travelled", "period started"…
diary.saved_anyway: What you entered has been saved.
diary.cmp_higher: Higher than your usual {{usual}} (last {{days}} days). Take it gently tomorrow.
diary.cmp_none: Keep logging for a few days to see how today compares.
diary.index_note: {{index}} is calculated from your answers only (no doctor's examination). It is for tracking, not diagnosis.

patterns.title: My patterns
patterns.subtitle: What is linked to your worse days?
patterns.need_more: You have {{have}} diary days. Patterns appear after {{need}}.
patterns.need_more_scope: Only {{have}} days of this kind so far. Patterns for it appear after {{need}}.
patterns.sentence: Followed by a worse day {{hits}} out of {{n}} times. Other days: {{bhits}} out of {{bn}}.
patterns.not_enough: Logged {{n}} times so far. We need at least {{need}} (and enough days without it) to say anything.
patterns.avg_index: Average {{index}} score: {{a}} on these days, {{b}} on other days.
patterns.sure_possible: How sure: not sure yet. More diary days will tell.
patterns.sure_not_linked: How sure: no link seen so far.
patterns.sure_not_enough_data: How sure: too early to say.
patterns.window_food: We look at the same day and the next day (6–48 hours after eating). Only high levels count.
patterns.window_sleep: We look at the day after that night, and the day after it.
patterns.window_stress: We look at the same day and the two days after.
patterns.window_period: We look at each day inside the period, and the day after.
patterns.window_medication: We look at the three days after a missed dose. Talk to your doctor about missed doses.
patterns.overlap: Mostly happened together with: {{list}}. We can't tell them apart yet.
patterns.footer: These are patterns in your own diary, not proven causes. A "worse day" means your score was at least 2 points above your recent usual, or a food bothered you. Please discuss them with your doctor, and never change your medicines because of this page.
patterns.how_1: Each night's diary gives one day of data: what you ate, how you slept, your stress, and your symptom score.
patterns.how_2: For each food type and habit, we count how often a worse day followed it, and how often on other days.
patterns.how_3: A statistical model (Bayesian, built only from your own diary) works out how sure we can be. At least 3 occurrences are needed.
patterns.how_4: The result is a pattern, not a cause. Things that happen together, like late nights in exam weeks, are flagged as overlapping.
patterns.graph_note: Numbers show how sure we are of a link (0–100). Thicker lines mean a stronger link.

risk.title: Next {{days}} days
risk.level_raised: Your flare risk is higher than usual
risk.level_high: Your flare risk is high right now
risk.calm: Nothing unusual in the last few days.
risk.not_enough: Keep filling in the diary. The outlook needs about two weeks of data.
risk.driver_trend: Your score is {{value}} points above your usual
risk.advice: Gentler meals and regular sleep may help. If symptoms keep rising, contact your doctor. This is a simple, transparent score, not a diagnosis.

gut.title: My Gut
gut.subtitle: Your remission and flare periods, kept apart.
gut.proposal: It looks like a flare started on {{date}}. Is that right?
gut.proposal_text: Your {{index}} score was {{at}} or more on at least {{need}} of {{of}} days. Your answer decides.
gut.chart_note: Dashed line: {{index}} {{at}}, the level counted as active disease. Shaded: flare periods.
gut.keep_logging: Keep logging for {{need}} days to see your periods.
gut.compare: Remission and flare, side by side
gut.no_days_of_kind: No days of this kind yet.
gut.before_none: None of your known contributors were logged that week.
gut.before_note: Only your likely or possible contributors are counted. This shows what happened that week. It doesn't tell us why the flare started.
gut.mark_flare_hint: For example, when your doctor confirmed a flare. Your marking always wins.
gut.stress_periods_hint: Exams, deadlines, travel, fasting. Mark them before or after, and HappyGut checks whether they change your symptoms.
gut.add_period_hint: Every diary day inside it is tagged automatically.
gut.footer: Periods are proposed from your daily {{index}} score: a flare when the score is active on 3 of 4 days, remission after 7 calm days. You confirm or reject every flare, and you can mark your own.

history.title: Meal history
history.subtitle: Every meal you checked, with its verdict and evidence.

report.title: Doctor's report
report.subtitle: One page to bring to your next appointment.
report.heading: Pre-visit summary
report.contributors_note: Counts are days followed by a worse day. Patterns from the patient's own diary; not proven causes.
report.footer: {{index}} is patient-reported (no examination items). Periods are proposed from the daily score and confirmed by the patient.
report.sample_data: Generated from sample data in a demonstration account.

settings.title: Settings
settings.safety_1: HappyGut never calls a food "safe", never gives advice about starting, stopping or changing medicines, and stops all food advice when you report a warning sign.
settings.safety_2: Heavy bleeding, fever with stomach pain, vomiting with no stool or gas, or signs of severe dehydration need a doctor or emergency care straight away.
settings.ph_ibs_like_symptoms: IBS-like symptoms when my disease is quiet
settings.profile_note: Your verdicts, food guide and meal ideas update as soon as you change these.
settings.notify_note: Reminders appear while HappyGut is open or installed on this device.
settings.notify_blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings to turn reminders on.
settings.restore_note: Puts this account's diary, meals and profile back to how they were at the start.

notice.title: Before you begin
notice.data: You are entering a demonstration account. The profile, diary and health records in it are sample data, not a real person's records.
notice.purpose: HappyGut is a prototype built for the International AI Builders Congress 2026. Its food knowledge was reviewed by an AI judge against published sources, not by clinicians, and it has not been clinically validated.
notice.medical: Please don't use it to make medical decisions. For any health concern, follow your doctor's advice.

foods.title: Food guide
foods.subtitle: Every dish we know, judged for you.
foods.none: No dish matches. Try checking it as a meal.
foods.plan_intro: A week of ideas built only from the {{n}} dishes rated "likely OK" for you right now. Swap freely.
foods.plan_none: Not enough dishes are rated "likely OK" for you right now to build a week of ideas.
foods.footer: Verdicts come from HappyGut's rules engine using IBD guidance and your own diary. They change when your profile, your diary or your flare state changes. These are ideas, not a prescribed diet; a dietitian can tailor a plan to you.
